Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Trip Way's pricing carousel - swiping the "Upgrade to Pro" screen slides between benefit pages ("Unlimited Trips", "Sync Across Devices", "Go Pro. Travel Smarter.") with staggered illustration and text transitions.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light purple screen: close X and "Upgrade to Pro" title, a floating illustration per page (boarding-pass and ticket cluster; phone + tablet; feature checklist), a bold page title with subline, page dots, a dark "Start My 7-day Free Trial" button, and a "Restore Purchases" link.

## Motion spec
Pattern: staggered swipe carousel, ~400ms.
- Swipe: the illustration slides out in the drag direction 1:1 while fading (to 0 over 80% travel); the incoming illustration slides in from the other side starting at 60px offset (ease-out, 300ms).
- Stagger: the title follows the illustration +80ms, the subline +140ms - each sliding 24px with fade.
- Snap: release settles on the nearest page (spring ~340/24); the active dot fills and elongates (200ms).
- Loop edge: no wrap - the last page resists with rubber-band (0.4x) and springs back.

## Calibration
- The CTA and dots never slide - only illustration, title, and subline transition.
- The checklist page enters with its rows cascading (40ms stagger) after the title lands.

## Reduced motion
Pages crossfade (250ms) without stagger.

## Don't miss
- The stagger order is illustration, title, subline - reversing it breaks the rhythm.
- The button stays dark and static; it is not part of the carousel.
